regressions.message: New CRITICAL pipeline anti-pattern HARDCODED_SECRET in playwright.yml.

new_antipatterns.message: Job 'playwright' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.
Potential hardcoded credential in job 'playwright' step env 'PASSWORD'. Use GitHub Secrets instead.
